buffer_loss_visibility.detail: Measured gaps: output-limit drops were reported (1,277,656 records), but the helper has no buffer cap, so a slow consumer grew the backlog (72 MiB, 224 s flush) instead of dropping visibly, and under Nsight the helper captured 0-1 records while reporting a clean finalize.
